scenario.title: Preserve dollar contracts when charges use cents

affected.reason: Line 16 sums p.amount values and rounds to 2 decimal places assuming dollars; after patch the sum is ~100x larger and represents cents, silently returning a wrong total to every caller.
affected.fix: Divide the sum by 100 before returning, or update callers to expect cents.

affected.reason: Line 15 formats payment.amount with ':.2f' as dollars; after patch the message reads '$10320.00' instead of '$103.20'.
affected.fix: Divide payment.amount by 100 before formatting the f-string.

affected.reason: Line 16 passes payment.amount through as a dict value with no dollar assumption; the function is unit-agnostic.
Line 7 formats payment.amount with ':.2f' as dollars; after patch amount is in cents so output becomes '$10320.00' instead of '$103.20'.
affected.fix: Divide payment.amount by 100 before formatting, or change the format string to show cents.
affected.snippet:
from shop.users.service import get_user


def render_receipt(payment: Payment) -> str:
    user = get_user(payment.user_id)
    return f"Receipt for {user.name}: ${payment.amount:.2f}"

affected.reason: Line 9 only appends the Payment object to a list; no numeric interpretation of amount.
affected.snippet:
_PAYMENTS: List[Payment] = []


def save_payment(payment: Payment) -> Payment:
    _PAYMENTS.append(payment)
    return payment

affected.reason: Returns the stored list as-is; no numeric operation on amount.
Line 12 echoes payment.amount directly into the JSON response without any dollar assumption; the API contract now returns cents, which callers must handle.

infraImpact.trigger: shop/payments/charge.py may invalidate COPY/ADD inputs or a dependent stage
infraImpact.suggestion: Copy dependency manifests before application code. Indices are Dockerfile instructions; cache effects are conservative and build time is unmeasured.

conventions.naming: snake_case functions and variables; PascalCase domain models/exceptions. Evidence: shop/users/service.py, shop/errors.py.
conventions.imports: Absolute imports at module scope, usually from-imports. Ordering is mixed. Evidence: shop/orders/service.py, shop/users/routes.py, shop/payments/repo.py.
conventions.errorHandling: Services raise typed NotFoundError/ValidationError; routes use HTTP errors. Safe decoys may return False explicitly. Evidence: shop/orders/service.py, shop/errors.py, shop/notifications/email.py.
conventions.fileLayout: Separate service, route, schema and repo modules; tests mirror modules. Evidence: shop/users/service.py, shop/users/routes.py, tests/users/test_service.py, tests/payments/test_routes.py.
conventions.scope: Observed on restored baseline; compliance checks added-line naming, absolute/module-level imports, and typed raises. Semantic contract correctness is verified by tests.
